ops.originalText: Pick up The Ashenvale Hunt from Jorn Skyseer in The Barrens.
ops.text: Keep the 6382 accept. 882 is accepted, completed, and turned in in barrens-12-20. 6382 is a talk to Senani, not a hunt.

sources.label: Questie 6382 pre.single 882, objectivesText speak with Senani, xp 390, no next

ops.originalText: Turn in The Ashenvale Hunt to Senani Thunderheart in Ashenvale.
ops.text: Keep the 6382 turn-in. It is the Senani handoff. Do not add a long hunt.

sources.label: Questie 6382 has no objectives; 6383 has empty pre, no objectives, no xp
